001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import java.util.Arrays;
004
005import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
006import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
007import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
008
009/**
010 * Once-a-day Tandem Mobi summary of the BLE connections made to the pump. The pump writes it every
011 * 24 hours counted from its last restart, not at midnight, so its time of day differs between pumps
012 * and each record covers the 24 hours since the previous one. The header timestamp is the end of
013 * that period.
014 *
015 * <p>The counts were compared with the connections and JPAKE authentications TandemKit logged in
016 * 12 day-long windows on two pumps (the maintainer's and a tester's).
017 * {@link #getConnections()} minus {@link #getUnauthenticatedConnections()} equalled the number of
018 * authenticated sessions in all 12 windows. The class name is provisional: opcode 474 is not in
019 * Tandem's cloud event schema or the Mobi app's history log list. Fields not named here have not
020 * been identified and are exposed raw. See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpx2/issues/152.
021 */
022
023/**
024 * History log record BLE Daily Connections, opCode 474, size 26.
025 *
026 * <br>
027 *
028 * Once-a-day Tandem Mobi summary of the BLE connections made to the pump. The pump writes it every
029 * 24 hours counted from its last restart, not at midnight, so its time of day differs between pumps
030 * and each record covers the 24 hours since the previous one. The header timestamp is the end of
031 * that period.
032 *
033 * <p>The counts were compared with the connections and JPAKE authentications TandemKit logged in
034 * 12 day-long windows on two pumps (the maintainer's and a tester's).
035 * {@link #getConnections()} minus {@link #getUnauthenticatedConnections()} equalled the number of
036 * authenticated sessions in all 12 windows. The class name is provisional: opcode 474 is not in
037 * Tandem's cloud event schema or the Mobi app's history log list. Fields not named here have not
038 * been identified and are exposed raw. See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpx2/issues/152.
039 *
040 * 
041 * <table border='1'>
042 * <caption>Message properties:</caption>
043 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>opCode</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>474</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
044 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>displayName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>"BLE Daily Connections"</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
045 * </table>
046 */@HistoryLogProps(
047    opCode = 474,
048    displayName = "BLE Daily Connections"
049)
050public class BleDailyConnectionsHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
051
052    private int connectedPercent;
053    private int unknown11;
054    private int connections;
055    private int unauthenticatedConnections;
056    private byte[] unknownTail;
057
058    public BleDailyConnectionsHistoryLog() {}
059    public BleDailyConnectionsHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int connectedPercent, int unknown11, int connections, int unauthenticatedConnections, byte[] unknownTail) {
060        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
061        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, connectedPercent, unknown11, connections, unauthenticatedConnections, unknownTail);
062        this.connectedPercent = connectedPercent;
063        this.unknown11 = unknown11;
064        this.connections = connections;
065        this.unauthenticatedConnections = unauthenticatedConnections;
066        this.unknownTail = Arrays.copyOfRange(this.cargo, 16, 26);
067    }
068
069    public BleDailyConnectionsHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int connectedPercent, int unknown11, int connections, int unauthenticatedConnections) {
070        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, connectedPercent, unknown11, connections, unauthenticatedConnections, new byte[10]);
071    }
072
073    public int typeId() {
074        return 474;
075    }
076
077    /**
078     * <table border="1">
079     * <caption>Parsed fields for BleDailyConnectionsHistoryLog:</caption>
080     * <tr><td><code>connectedPercent</code></td><td><code>raw[10] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
081     * <tr><td><code>unknown11</code></td><td><code>raw[11] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
082     * <tr><td><code>connections</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 12)</code></td></tr>
083     * <tr><td><code>unauthenticatedConnections</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
084     * <tr><td><code>unknownTail</code></td><td><code>Arrays.copyOfRange(raw, 16, 26)</code></td></tr>
085     * </table>
086     */
087    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
088        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
089        this.cargo = raw;
090        parseBase(raw);
091        this.connectedPercent = raw[10] & 0xFF;
092        this.unknown11 = raw[11] & 0xFF;
093        this.connections = Bytes.readShort(raw, 12);
094        this.unauthenticatedConnections = Bytes.readShort(raw, 14);
095        this.unknownTail = Arrays.copyOfRange(raw, 16, 26);
096    }
097
098    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int connectedPercent, int unknown11, int connections, int unauthenticatedConnections, byte[] unknownTail) {
099        Validate.isTrue(unknownTail.length == 10, "unknownTail must be 10 bytes");
100        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
101            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(474, 0),
102            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
103            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
104            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(connectedPercent),
105            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(unknown11),
106            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(connections),
107            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unauthenticatedConnections),
108            unknownTail));
109    }
110
111    /**
112     * The share of the 24 hours during which the pump had a BLE connection, apparently rounded to
113     * the nearest percent. Values of 97-100 were observed. It matched the phone-side connected time
114     * in 11 of 12 windows; the twelfth was 0.02 points below the rounding threshold. It read 100
115     * with {@link #getConnections()} 0 on a day with no reconnection.
116     * Medium confidence.
117     *
118     * @return percent of the period with a BLE connection, 0-100
119     */
120    public int getConnectedPercent() {
121        return connectedPercent;
122    }
123
124    /**
125     * Constant per pump: 6 on both of the maintainer's Mobis, 4 on a tester's. Its meaning is
126     * unknown, and it is not a firmware or model code.
127     *
128     * @return raw uint8 at offset 11
129     */
130    public int getUnknown11() {
131        return unknown11;
132    }
133
134    /**
135     * BLE connections the pump accepted during the period, including ones that failed encryption
136     * or never authenticated. Values of 0-66 were observed. This equalled the connections the phone
137     * logged (connects plus encryption failures) in 8 of 12 windows. In the other 4 it was exactly
138     * 2 higher, from connections the phone never reported. Byte 13 was 0 in every record, so it is
139     * read as a uint16; byte 12 alone gives the same values.
140     *
141     * @return number of BLE connections in the period
142     */
143    public int getConnections() {
144        return connections;
145    }
146
147    /**
148     * Connections during the period that never completed JPAKE authentication (key confirmation),
149     * including failed encryption and links dropped during setup. Values of 0-11 were observed. The
150     * value was 0 exactly on the days the phone logged no failed, cancelled or timed-out
151     * connection. Byte 15 was always 0, so it is read as a uint16, like {@link #getConnections()}.
152     *
153     * @return number of connections that did not authenticate
154     */
155    public int getUnauthenticatedConnections() {
156        return unauthenticatedConnections;
157    }
158
159    /**
160     * Equal to the authenticated sessions TandemKit logged in 12 of 12 windows on two pumps.
161     *
162     * @return {@link #getConnections()} minus {@link #getUnauthenticatedConnections()}
163     */
164    public int getAuthenticatedConnections() {
165        return connections - unauthenticatedConnections;
166    }
167
168    /**
169     * Bytes 16-25. Zero in every record examined. No new pairing happened in any window
170     * examined, so a pairing counter here would also have read 0.
171     *
172     * @return a copy of bytes 16-25
173     */
174    public byte[] getUnknownTail() {
175        return Arrays.copyOf(unknownTail, unknownTail.length);
176    }
177}
